integrity: The local covariance is derived directly from independent parent choices and an exact leaf-survival product. The equal-share identity follows by summing the local covariance over possible older leaves. Exhaustive recursive-tree enumeration and exact rational arithmetic replay the formulas independently.
scientific_limitations: The model is the standard random recursive tree with independent uniform parent choices.
The result concerns covariance and correlation, not a complete joint law or positive association.
Older recursive-tree literature may contain an equivalent mixed root-degree/leaf-count moment under different notation.
title: Equal-share covariance of root degree and leaves in a random recursive tree
